system.description: Spend three Blood Traits (transformation takes three turns, cannot be hastened, but the character may act normally during it) to become a culturally-rooted mythic beast (griffin, thunderbird, sphinx, dragon, etc. — characters from cultures without a mythic-beast tradition cannot use this power). Grants nine bonus Traits (at least one each to Strength/Dexterity/Stamina-related categories, remainder flexible), two extra Bruised and two extra Hurt health levels, the effects of Heightened Senses, Eyes of the Beast, and Awe, three levels of aggravated close-combat damage divided among natural weapons, and one ranged attack per turn (Physical Challenge; two levels of aggravated damage per Blood Trait spent, range and area scaled to Physical Trait total). Sample form (Dragon) given in the source: flight, three levels of armor, one-level bite and claw, fiery-breath ranged attack.
